A '''ballista''' was a piece of siege equipment that fired large [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]]. The [[Anointed People]] of [[Abonshee]] were known to have employed ballistae,<ref name="Godking" /> as did the [[Sevari]] of [[Sevarcos II]], who mounted them on their [[wind rider]]s.<ref name="Free Trader" />
